The gallery is organized as small research albums. The first pass separates
FEM shell benchmarks, cultural heritage case studies and innovative materials;
the masonry album can be expanded as soon as dedicated figures are selected.

## Planned collections

| Collection | Scope | Next data needed |
|---|---|---|
| Masonry | Texture-aware models, interfaces, damage and seismic assessment | Select 6-10 figures from masonry papers and case studies |
| Cultural heritage | Digital twins, monitoring, point clouds and structural assessment | Add final captions and project metadata |
| FEM | Shell, beam, VEM and nonlinear benchmark results | Add DOI/preprint links and benchmark descriptions |
| Innovative materials | Bio-based aggregates, experiments and material characterization | Add accepted paper metadata and test protocol links |
